messages:
Maya Lopez: hey all -- first week, env is green. about to make my first code change. quick: branch naming, commit format, and who to ping for a newbie review?
Arjun Patel: welcome Maya! Branch: `me/ml-<ticket>-<short>` for personal work. For cross-team features use `feat/<ticket>-<short>`.
Arjun Patel: commit style: one-line header (<=72 chars), blank line, short body. If it's a bug include `Fixes: #NNN`. Example: `fix(api): validate input on create`
Maya Lopez: awesome. reviewers?
Arjun Patel: request the path owner + one buddy. If unsure, ping `@devex` or `@eng`. For first PRs folks often volunteer to pair-review.
Maya Lopez: merge strategy?
Arjun Patel: squash-merge for most PRs. Keep PR description detailed so the squash commit is useful.
CI Bot: [automated] reminder: run `pre-commit run --all-files` and unit tests locally before opening.
Maya Lopez: thanks! I'll open a draft and ping here when ready.
Arjun Patel: I'll do the first pass :)
